title: ygjson archetypes
description: data/archetypes.json: the archetypes and series cards can belong to. Members are derived from the cards' archetypes lists at build time.

slug.description: The slug of the name, deduplicated with -2, -3 when two names slug alike (D.D. and D/D).

names.description: The name in each language YGOJSON has one for.

isArchetype.description: False for a series Konami does not call an archetype. Set by import_ygojson.

source.description: Where the archetype was first seen.
